selected_experiment.candidate_rule: When WHNF sees LE.le.{0} Nat instLENat applied to zero or more remaining arguments, return Nat.le applied to those same remaining arguments.
guards: only WHNF reduction authority is used

target_gate.semantic_status: candidate and cold statuses must match on both deep-list targets
target_gate.performance: candidate must reduce semantic steps or wall time on at least one target

corpus_gate.public_arena: candidate must introduce zero wrong verdicts on the current public Arena corpus

post_result_policy.if_target_and_corpus_green: promote as verified Lean capability, compile direct transition, reclose and rerank
post_result_policy.if_semantically_green_but_economically_n: retain in reserve, compile preference result, reclose

claim_boundary: The diagnostic licenses only this prospectively guarded candidate. No general typeclass-projection shortcut or arbitrary LE instance rewrite is authorized.
